ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black pigment mass centered at the notch, extending outwards in a dendritic pattern. The lateral lobes are predominantly white with high-frequency black focal spots and mottling at the pigment transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated 40-degree internal angle; depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; several small jagged indentations concentrated on the inner trailing edges near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the leading edge transition to the trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular dark pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed on both lobes; two prominent clusters on the mid-right lobe and several smaller clusters on the upper-left lobe distal section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark linear disruptions; a prominent diagonal mark on the far left lobe and multiple shorter, horizontal scratch marks on the lower right lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/amputation on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Continuous dark pigmentation border along the distal edges of both fluke lobes.
